vendor_experience_required.value: no stated minimum years or project count; Proponents should provide: a brief company history including length of time in business and years providing requested goods/services; experience in providing LMS systems and support or support for existing Moodle LMS; experience working with post-secondary institutions, including those using Ellucian Banner; staff/resource experience and qualifications; proposed subcontracted resources experience and qualifications; staffing model with resumes for proposed staff and identification of any work to be subcontracted.
vendor_experience_required.quote:
8.1 Company Experience (15 Points)
Proponents should provide the following information in their Proposals:
a) a brief company history, including the length of time the company has been in business and the number of years providing the goods and services requested in this RFP;
b) a copy of the Proponent’s organizational structure, reporting structure, number of employees, etc.;
c) an outline of the Proponent’s experience in providing the goods and services set out in this RFP, including providing LMS systems and support; or support for the existing Moodle LMS (if applicable)
d) the Proponent’s experience working with post-secondary institutions previously, including with institutions that utilize Ellucian Banner
8.2 Staff/Resource Experience (5 points)
Proponents should provide the following information in their Proposals:
a) Staff and resource experience and qualifications,
b) Proposed subcontracted resources - experience and qualifications (if applicable)
c) A staffing model that designates personnel assigned to the project, including:
i. resumes for any staff members proposed to work on the Project, and
ii. identification of any work to be subcontracted.

value: Maintaining data security standards to safeguard sensitive learning materials and learner information
Ability to adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA)
Proponents must be able to provide a HECVAT cybersecurity & privacy assessment
State whether the platform supports “local” Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) support or whether MFA is dependent on the above SSO integration

The Contractor and each of its employees and sub-contractors shall keep all sensitive information strictly confidential and shall not disclose or release such information or any portion of it, to any person whatsoever, except to Olds College and except as may be required at law.

If requested by Olds College, execute and deliver Olds College’s standard vendor confidentiality Agreement including any variations, if any, as Olds College reasonably determines are advisable having regard to the nature of the Services.

In the event that the Contractor obtains or gains access to any sensitive information that was not required for the performance of this Agreement, sensitive information in any form that the Contractor once had in its possession or control is lost, or stolen or is otherwise acquired by a third party without the consent of Olds College, or the Contractor has reasonable cause to believe that trespassers, hackers or any other third party has, by theft, through electronic means or otherwise, gained access to sensitive information without the consent of Olds College, then the Contractor shall promptly so advise Olds College and, if requested, provide a written report concerning such incident in such detail as Olds College shall reasonably require.

In regards to the Services, where Olds College deems it practical and appropriate, the Contractor may be required to, and in such event shall, promptly advise Olds College in writing of each occasion that the Contractor accesses Olds College’s electronic files, records or systems outside of normal business hours or from any off site location and shall not in any event do so without prior authorization.
data_security_requirements.quote:
Security
• Maintaining data security standards to safeguard sensitive learning materials and learner information
• Safeguards against data breaches
• Ability to adhere to Province of Alberta information privacy standards (POPA)
• Proponents must be able to provide a HECVAT cybersecurity & privacy assessment.
• SAML based Single Sign-On (SSO) integration
• State whether the platform supports “local” Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) support or whether MFA is dependent on the above SSO integration
